question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it cover HTTP routes only, WebSocket RPC methods, or both?
rationale: The choice defines public API coverage, auth and plugin-route exposure, generated-client support, and versioning guarantees, which are product/API-contract decisions rather than a narrow implementation bug.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose schema format, covered APIs, exposure path, and compatibility/security rules.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a versioned schema artifact for selected stable APIs without adding a runtime endpoint until auth and plugin-route exposure are settled.

options.title: Use Existing TypeBox Path
options.body: Close later only if maintainers explicitly decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema Gateway protocol artifacts are the supported client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose schema format, covered APIs, exposure path, and compatibility/security rules.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal for Gateway protocol/schema design and docs, where this public API decision lands.
